answer: Locks are recorded in ripple, expire in meadow, and karst lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 175 aliases as a result needs 23 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 8 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2893 identities would post 722 proofs and burn roughly 51 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
